name: dsh-notify-bell
description: DSH notification plugin with semantic sounds (done/block/permission/question/error): goal complete/block, approval/asked, ask_user_question, and agent/error notify via BEL or WAV. Official Cordis plugin form: Config schema, bundle patch (dsh.bundle), Web bell toggle in the session header. Configurable via cordis.yml or the legacy ~/.config/dsh/notify-bell.json (bellCount still accepted).
